title: SPOT scouter session (data model v2)
description: The saved copy of one registry entry (RT-24, DV-15). The server keeps the registry in memory and writes each change here in the background, so a restart keeps who holds which robot. Whether a scouter is connected is never stored: after a restart everyone is disconnected until their device reconnects.

_id.description: <event id>:<student id>, so one person has one entry per event (RT-24).

deviceId.description: The device the scouter signed in on, a random id it keeps (docs/spec/15). The stream and every action must name it, and signing in on another device moves the session there.

matchLevel.description: The level of `matchNumber`, or null with it (DV-17).

team.description: The robot this scouter holds (RT-25), or null.

accepted.description: The scouter has seen this assignment, so a reconnect does not show it again (RT-27).

entered.description: The scouter was sent into the match screen for this assignment (RT-12a), so it is not sent again.

signedInAt.description: When the scouter signed in; waiting scouters are assigned in this order (RT-11).
